7.3.1 Spot the Problem: The Module That Logged Everything
7.4 Every Response Is Signed, on the Abort Path Too

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-before-the-mac-check: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-before-the-mac-check: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-before-the-mac-check: 7.2 decides b: QueryHost sends in prepare without waiting for the vote and doesn't join, so the abort never reaches it and the network's approval stands.
recorded.prompt:q-leaked-log: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-leaked-log: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-leaked-log: 7.3.1 decides a: the Generate CBC-MAC entry holds the packed request in hex with the card number, and ProtectedLogListener passes a hex byte array untouched.
recorded.prompt:q-unsigned-decline: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unsigned-decline: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-unsigned-decline: 7.4 says the answer built on the abort path left unsigned because a plain participant isn't asked after an ABORTED vote, and that the terminal can't tell an unsigned decline from a forged one, so it reports the purchase as unknown, reverses it and raises a MAC alert.

recorded.prompt:q-before-the-mac-check:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-before-the-mac-check:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-before-the-mac-check:a: 7.2 says a participant that joined gets its abort to undo what it reserved, so the reservation is released.
recorded.prompt:q-before-the-mac-check:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-before-the-mac-check:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-before-the-mac-check:c: 7.2 says after an abort nothing commits, so a journal written in commit never gets its entry.
recorded.prompt:q-before-the-mac-check:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-before-the-mac-check:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-before-the-mac-check:d: 7.2 says what is in the Context never leaves our server, so a destination name there leaves nothing behind outside it.
recorded.prompt:q-leaked-log:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-leaked-log:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-leaked-log:b: 7.3 and 7.3.1: the logged TPK is under the LMK and the log reads PINs only with dev.lmk, which the stem says was not taken.
recorded.prompt:q-leaked-log:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-leaked-log:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-leaked-log:c: 7.3.1 says ProtectedLogListener masks fields of a message in the event, and a byte array in hex is not a message.
recorded.prompt:q-leaked-log:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-leaked-log:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-leaked-log:d: 7.3.1 shows twelve digits in the translation entry but the whole card number in the MAC entry's hex.
recorded.prompt:q-unsigned-decline:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unsigned-decline:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-unsigned-decline:a: 7.4 says a MAC-checking terminal believes only an answer that verifies under its key, and shows the unsigned 91 reported as 'UNKNOWN (MAC missing)'.
recorded.prompt:q-unsigned-decline:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unsigned-decline:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-unsigned-decline:b: 7.4 says that after the ABORTED vote only abort participants are asked, and PlainSignResponse isn't one.
recorded.prompt:q-unsigned-decline:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unsigned-decline:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-unsigned-decline:d: 7.4 says the abort-path answer leaves unsigned ('MAC missing'), so it carries no MAC at all; the page never mentions another terminal's key, so ruling that out is an inference.
